footnotes: Fourth quarters (Q4 2024, Q4 2025) have no 10-Q: they are the full year in the 10-K less the nine months in the third-quarter 10-Q.
Cash flow figures are reported year-to-date; each quarter is the year-to-date total less the previous quarter's. Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property and equipment.
Debt = long-term debt including the current portion; excludes leases.
The company reports no cost of revenue line, so net revenue flows straight to operating expenses.
The company reports no operating income line; pre-tax income is shown instead.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding. QoQ compares with Q3 2025; YoY with Q4 2024.

events.t: Effective February 12, 2026, Sumita Pandit no longer serves as President and Chief Financial Officer of Radian Group Inc. (the “Company”).

Appointment of Directors On February 9, 2026, upon the recommendation of the Governance Committee of the board of directors (the “Board”) of Radian Group Inc. Other Events On December 29, 2025, Radian Group Inc. (“Radian” or the “Company”) entered into a $600 million note (the “Intercompany Note”) with Radian Guaranty Inc., (“RGI”) its wholly owned subsidiary.

On November 4, 2025, Radian Group Inc. (“Radian”) entered into a credit agreement (the “Credit Agreement”) with Royal Bank of Canada, as Administrative Agent (the “Agent”), and certain other banks and financial institutions serving as lenders (collectively with their successors and assigns, the “Lenders”).
